summary: Iter 229k — Verified team theme_color wiring into UI (Draft Board column headers + Trade Block owner chip) and DraftRoom decomposition into 4 extracted hooks. Live test against deployed preview as commissioner chriszarek. Set theme_color=#0ea5e9 on Zarek's Frozen (ZF) via PUT /api/teams/{id}, then loaded /draft-room and /trade-block. RESULT: (1) Draft Board renders 12 column headers each with data-testid=draft-board-col-header-{abbr}; ZF header background computed-style is rgb(14,165,233) — exact match for #0ea5e9; non-themed BAD header falls back to secondary bg rgba(26,26,26,0.5); on-the-clock highlight + my-team accent logic preserved. (2) Trade Block tile rendered TEST item with TeamLogo chip (h-8 w-8 rounded-full, text 'ZF') whose backgroundColor === rgb(14,165,233) — proves themeColor prop reaches TeamLogo and is applied. Existing non-themed owner chips kept default styling. (3) DraftRoom.tsx hydrates cleanly: zero console errors / page errors on initial load + navigation + filter toggle interaction. The 4 new hooks (use-live-picks-by-orig-key, use-expanded-player-fetch, use-draft-queue-shortlist-persistence, use-draft-audio-alerts) are imported at lines 90-93 and the page renders the player-preview panel, draft countdown, Start Draft buttons, and the full 21+ round draft board without runtime errors. No critical or minor bugs found in this iteration's changes.

minor.issue: Cannot clear theme_color: body {"theme_color": null} and {"theme_color": ""} both return updated:false (no-op). Was acknowledged in the review request — flagging here so a future iteration can add an explicit clear path (e.g. accept null, or DELETE /api/teams/{id}/theme-color).

action_items: (Optional) Allow PUT /api/teams/{id} with theme_color=null to clear the saved color so test/staging data can be reset. Currently the validator drops null and "" silently.
(Optional) Add a data-testid to the TradeBlock owner chip (e.g. trade-block-owner-chip-{itemId}) for future deterministic selection — right now we have to query by computed bg or by text content.
critical_code_review_comments: DraftBoard.tsx L129-156: theme_color column header logic is clean and correctly preserves the on-the-clock + my-team highlights via ring-* utility when a custom bg is applied. data-testid=draft-board-col-header-{abbr} and data-theme-color attributes make this trivially testable.

TradeBlock.tsx L279-282: ownerThemeColorFor uses leagueTeams.find(tt => tt.owner_id === ownerId). This matches the trade-block item's owner_id against the team owner — works for items posted by an actual team owner, but in this seed data many trade-block items reference owner_ids that do not match any team.owner_id (teams have owner_id=null but items have stale phantom owner_ids), so those chips fall back to default styling. Not a bug introduced this iter — pre-existing seed-data inconsistency.

DraftRoom.tsx L90-93 + extracted hooks: Decomposition is purely semantic-preserving — boardTeams now carries theme_color into DraftBoard/Sidebar, and all 4 effect blocks (live picks fetch, expanded-player fetch, queue/shortlist localStorage persistence, audio alerts) are encapsulated. File is still 999 lines so further decomposition is recommended but not blocking.
Hook files are small (49-58 lines each) and single-purpose — good extraction granularity. They use plain useEffect with proper dependency arrays.
TradeBlock.tsx still 972 lines — should be split (filter bar, tile card, my-players tab) but that's outside this iter's scope.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — Draft Board theme color verified rgb(14,165,233) on ZF, fallback verified on BAD; Trade Block owner chip verified rendering ZF with theme color via TeamLogo; zero console errors on both pages
